scope: Scanner raw video to native dense predictions and colored POINTS GLB; no SKU matching, Viewer, Surfel, COS or browser milestone
code_state: main plus pre-existing dirty/untracked Scanner and PromptDA integration; no production-source edits by this task

da3.native_precision: DA3 native BF16 autocast; FP32 parameters; joint multi-view request
da3.cache_state: One model load per CLI process; no external warmup; filesystem page cache unknown/unflushed; allocator/model caches retained between requests
da3.predict_scope: Resident model + prepared PNG paths and sensor arrays through dense predictions and processed RGB on CPU; caller synchronizes GPU before and after predict_candidate
da3.gpu_memory_scope: Per-predict absolute allocated/reserved peaks include model; baseline sampled then peak counters reset before request; no cache emptying

cold_artifacts.scope: One continuous cold predict, output check, NPZ save, GLB export/readback; excludes model load and prepared metadata load

warm_summary.scope: Three complete resident-model requests; no duplicate NPZ or GLB writes; no tail percentile claims

host_rss.scope: This PID only, after sampler startup; no child-process RSS or pre-sampler import peak
host_rss.limitation: Observed sampled peaks can miss brief allocation spikes

limitations: Current production configurations are not equal-resolution or equal-input comparisons.
Cold is a fresh model/process; filesystem page cache is not flushed.
One full raw run and three resident warm requests per candidate; no tail-latency or multi-scene inference.
Driver/RSS peaks are sampled; CPU tree RSS sums can double-count shared pages.
Fine-grained diagnostic and operator-profile requests are distinct from the baseline.
No independent geometric accuracy, product matching, footprint or visual-quality acceptance.
One orchestration stopped at a transient post-exit GPU utilization preflight; retained and completed via explicit new PromptDA attempt.
